description: ρ_K^full producer-side primitive: emits the tensor-product |tr_M(β_p ⊗ β_n ⊗ …)| via the Wenzl LR bridge (PR #674). ⚠ **Output is NOT the canonical |tr_M(β_canonical)|** — the canonical atomic braid is not a tensor product (inter-nucleon arc crossings break tensor structure), and the two diverge by ~80 % on D, T, ³He per `cross_check_trM_wenzl_lr_1ppb.py`. The canonical mass-derivation consumer is `canonical_tr_m_via_rust.py` (via `hecke-canonical-chi` Rust binary), which handles the averaged-crossing structure correctly. This script's witness is retained as an audit-only building block for a future non-tensor Wenzl bridge per `hecke-branching-trace-decomposition.md`.
